item.title: Trump and Xi adopt cordial tone at summit despite tensions
item.description: On Thursday, the two leaders will meet, with Trump and Xi expected to discuss artificial intelligence, rare earths, trade and geopolitics.

item.title: Judge restores journalists' White House access; Tucker Carlson on MAGA split
item.description: A judge ordered the Trump administration to restore journalists' White House access. Tucker Carlson speaks with Morning Edition's Steve Inskeep.

item.title: Economic pressures drive rising poverty among older adults
item.description: Overall poverty has declined, but the rate for seniors has climbed steadily in recent years. A new AARP survey examines how those over 50 are affected.

item.title: RFK Jr. Ethics Filing Shows Millions in Book Deals
item.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s annual financial disclosure shows two lucrative book advances and free flights from a friend.
